title_en: At the University Trauma Hospital, 3+1+2 apartment for sale, with a regular floor plan!!!
description_en: At the University Trauma Hospital, 3+1+2 apartment for sale, with a regular floor plan!!! The apartment is located on the 6th floor of a 6-story building without an elevator and has an area of ​​116.7 m2. It is organized by living room, kitchen, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 1 balcony. The property is sold furnished except for electrical appliances. The area where the property is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and quiet life.
